metadata.case_name: YAU YUK LAN v. INTERNATIONAL NATURAL THERAPY RESEARCH CENTRE LIMITED

injuries.description: First degree burn on abdomen with resultant scarring / post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation measuring 90 x 100 mm
source: the hot part of the device burned [the plaintiff’s] abdomen.
“… as the result of the treatment [the plaintiff] suffered first degree burn on her abdomen and left some scarring over the skin of the treated area measured 90 x 100 mm.”
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

manifestations.description: pain initially when lamp fell (awoke from trance and screamed)
multiple parallel lines of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation and scarring (area described as 8 cm x 8 cm by Dr TS Au; later described as 90 x 100 mm by Dr Otto Au)
many vertical fine linear pigmentation adjacent and lateral to the level of the umbilicus, flat and smooth, no pain on palpation
emotional disturbance (advised to consult a psychologist)
deterrence from swimming and playing badminton for fear others might see her scars

treatments_received: soothing / anti-inflammatory agent applied by defendant's staff immediately after accident
consultation and treatment by Dr TS Au between September 2010 and February 2011
treatments_future: laser treatment (about 10 treatments at 3-4 week intervals as recommended by Dr Otto Au)
consultation with a psychologist (advised by Dr Otto Au)
frequent proper wound dressings (as initially suggested by Dr Otto Au)

losses.description: Permanent cosmetic impairment / hyperpigmentation / scarring of abdomen (measuring 90 x 100 mm) causing cosmetic deformity and self-consciousness

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Deterrence from swimming and playing badminton for fear others might see her scars
Disharmonious relationship with her boyfriend since the accident

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Wearing longer clothing since the accident to avoid revealing the scars
